name: ISO 27001:2022
description: International Standard for Information Security Management Systems

controls.name: Policies for Information Security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external interested parties.

controls.name: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

controls.name: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.

controls.name: Management Responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all employees to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.name: Contact with Authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.name: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: The organization shall collect and analyze information about threats to determine and produce threat intelligence.

controls.name: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets shall be compiled and maintained.

controls.name: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and reviewed.

controls.name: Return of Assets
controls.description: All employees and external party personnel shall return all organizational assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment or engagement.

controls.name: Classification of Information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the organization's information classification policy.

controls.name: Labelling of Information
controls.description: Information classified by the organization shall be labelled according to the classification scheme.

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and documented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.name: Authentication Information
controls.description: The allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process supported by appropriate technical controls.

controls.name: Access Rights
controls.description: The provisioning, review, modification and removal of access to information and other associated assets shall be managed based on authorized access rights.

controls.name: Information Security for Cloud Services
controls.description: The organization shall define and manage information security aspects of cloud services usage.

controls.name: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents.

controls.name: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.description: Information security events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security incidents.

controls.name: Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

controls.name: Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen the information security management system.

controls.name: Information Security During Disruption
controls.description: The organization shall maintain information security during a disruption.

controls.name: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
controls.description: The organization shall maintain ICT readiness to ensure continuity of operations during a disruption.

controls.name: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
controls.description: The organization shall identify, document and keep up to date legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.

controls.name: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.description: The organization shall implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.name: Protection of Records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.

controls.name: Privacy and Protection of PII
controls.description: The organization shall identify and address privacy requirements including those imposed by legislation, regulation and contracts.

controls.name: Independent Review of Information Security
controls.description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be independently reviewed at planned intervals.

controls.name: Compliance with Policies, Rules and Standards
controls.description: Compliance with the organization's policies, rules and standards for information security shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.name: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and available to those who need them.

controls.name: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out prior to joining the organization.

controls.name: Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.description: Employment contractual agreements shall state the employees' and the organization's responsibilities for information security.

controls.name: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
controls.description: Employees of the organization and relevant external party personnel shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training.

controls.name: Disciplinary Process
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be in place to take action against personnel who have committed a security breach.

controls.name: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
controls.description: The responsibilities and duties of employees and external party personnel that continue after termination or change of employment shall be defined, implemented and communicated.

controls.name: Confidentiality or Non-disclosure Agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented and reviewed.

controls.name: Remote Working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.

controls.name: Reporting Information Security Events
controls.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events.

controls.name: Physical Security Perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

controls.name: Physical Entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

controls.name: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.

controls.name: Physical Security Monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

controls.name: Protection Against Physical and Environmental Threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats shall be designed and implemented.

controls.name: Working in Secure Areas
controls.description: Physical working in secure areas shall be controlled.

controls.name: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately applied.

controls.name: Asset Return
controls.description: Employees and external party personnel shall return all organizational assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment or engagement.

controls.name: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets shall be compiled and maintained.

controls.name: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and reviewed.

controls.name: Supporting Utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.name: Cabling Security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.name: Equipment Maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

controls.name: Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that data and licensed software are removed prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.name: User Endpoint Devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.name: Privileged Access Rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.name: Information Access Restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.name: Access to Source Code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

controls.name: Secure Authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.name: Capacity Management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted to ensure required capacity and system performance.

controls.name: Protection Against Malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate awareness measures.

controls.name: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained, evaluated and appropriate measures taken.

controls.name: Configuration Management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be defined, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.name: Information Deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.name: Data Masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other relevant topic-specific policies.

controls.name: Data Leakage Prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

controls.name: Information Backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.name: Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

controls.name: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, kept, protected and analysed.

controls.name: Monitoring Activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.name: Time Synchronisation
controls.description: Clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronised to approved time sources.

controls.name: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.name: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

controls.name: Networks Security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.name: Security of Network Services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

controls.name: Segregation of Networks
controls.description: Groups of network services, systems and devices shall be segregated in the organization's networks.

controls.name: Web Filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.name: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

controls.name: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be defined and applied.

controls.name: Application Security Requirements
controls.description: Security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.name: Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
controls.description: Principles for secure system architecture and engineering shall be defined, documented and applied.

controls.name: Secure Coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.name: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented during the development and acceptance of systems.

controls.name: Outsourced Development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review outsourced system development activities.

controls.name: Separation of Development, Test and Production Environments
controls.description: Development, test and production environments shall be separated and secured.

controls.name: Change Management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

controls.name: Test Information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

controls.name: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
controls.description: Audits and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the auditor and appropriate management.
